_doc: Replay sources for s07_replay.py. 'tokens' = default Qwen3.5 tokens to collect; the level's replay_tokens in mixture.json override it (s07 collects 15% extra to cover dedup/decontamination losses; s09 then takes the exact mixture). Only the listed parquet files are read, and only random row groups of them, so nothing large is downloaded. Set enabled=false to skip a source. Licences: re-check each dataset card before use.
